# Framing Contractor Insurance

> Specialized commercial insurance for wood framing and rough-carpentry contractors — general liability, workers' compensation (class 5403), builder's risk, tools & equipment floaters, commercial auto, and contractor bonds. A division of Contractors Choice Agency (founded 2005, licensed all 50 states, NPN 8608479). A-rated carriers, 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response.

Framing Contractor Insurance helps framing crews and rough-carpentry contractors get coverage that actually fits the trade: GL without height exclusions, correctly coded workers' comp, builder's risk for the structure, and tools floaters for the gear that walks off jobsites. We shop A-rated specialty trades markets and turn around the certificates and additional-insured endorsements your GCs require.

## Coverage lines
- [General Liability](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/general-liability): Third-party bodily injury & property damage for framing operations — without the height exclusions budget policies hide.
- [Workers' Compensation](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/workers-compensation): Class 5403 carpentry — fall, nail-gun, and saw exposures coded right.
- [Commercial Auto](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/commercial-auto): Trucks, trailers, and lumber haulers, including hired/non-owned.
- [Builder's Risk](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/builders-risk): Course-of-construction coverage for the structure, lumber, and labor you frame.
- [Tools & Equipment / Inland Marine](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/inland-marine-equipment): Scheduled tools and installation floaters at replacement cost.
- [Commercial Property](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/property): Shop, yard, wall-panel plant, and inventory.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/umbrella-excess-liability): Layered limits to $10M+ for GC and developer requirements.
- [Contractor License & Surety Bonds](https://framingcontractorinsurance.com/services/contractors-bonds): License, permit, bid, and performance bonds.
